That poker night at my new Bangalore place is happening!!

This isn't for your typical startup mixer crowd.

Because real trust isn't built over lukewarm coffee and a LinkedIn QR code. What happens over a poker table is you see how people handle pressure, risk, and luck.

Ambition is tested when the chips are down, not when the slides are up.

I've spent Sundays working instead of brunching to build a circle where this is possible.

Bangalore doesn't reward the best networker; it rewards the best player.
The cost of living in Bangalore is a feature, not a bug!!
